recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless SDWG reintroduces a core ClinicalDocument profile or requests new document-principles prose beyond the current FHIR Documents and CDA-on-FHIR pages.
issue_request: FHIR-12963 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked for Composition Scope and Usage to link to clinicaldocument.html and for the clinical document page to state persistence, wholeness, stewardship, context, and potential-for-authentication principles.
initial_application: Jira records a Grahame Grieve application comment citing SVN revision 13014. Git-svn commit 04fb3079bd44513f51cffc189ec0828259a77715, 'GF#12963 - improve CDA related doco', added Composition CDA/ClinicalDocument-related Scope and Usage prose and changed the Composition spreadsheet source that later fed clinical-document profile introduction content.
additional_context: Later final decisions changed the target. FHIR-13426 and FHIR-25438 generalized Composition beyond document-only and clinical-only wording. FHIR-13528 reversed the temporary CDA-on-FHIR profile naming, and FHIR-34407 later removed the ClinicalDocument Composition profile entirely. The combined branch already includes the FHIR-13528 fix that removes the stale active ClinicalDocument profile link. Current fhir.ini keeps Composition active but comments out the legacy cda profile hook; the active hierarchy lists cda-intro.html, which already states the clinical document characteristics.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Restoring a clinicaldocument.html link from Composition would reintroduce a link to a removed core profile and conflict with later applied decisions. Current Composition source links to FHIR Documents and CDA comparison guidance, while active CDA-on-FHIR source carries the requested document principles.
